import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(df):
    if not isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame):
        raise ValueError("df must be a pandas DataFrame")

    data = df.loc[~df["name"].duplicated(keep=False), ["age", "score"]].dropna()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.scatter(data["age"], data["score"])

    if len(data) >= 2 and data["age"].nunique() > 1:
        try:
            slope, intercept, _, _, _ = stats.linregress(data["age"], data["score"])
            x_vals = data["age"].astype(float)
            x_line = pd.Series([x_vals.min(), x_vals.max()])
            y_line = slope * x_line + intercept
            ax.plot(x_line, y_line)
        except ValueError:
            pass

    ax.set_title("Linear Regression")
    ax.set_xlabel("Age")
    ax.set_ylabel("Score")

    return plt, ax
